description: Send a real quote request to People Can Build (creates an enquiry read by a person; reply by email usually within one business day). EXPERIMENTAL channel: e-mail to expo@peoplecanbuild.com remains the primary, guaranteed path — after calling this, tell the user a human will reply by e-mail and that they should e-mail expo@peoplecanbuild.com quoting the ticket id if nothing arrives within 2 business days. ALWAYS confirm the details with the user before calling. Check fit first: custom stands 16 to ~400 sqm (double-deck possible); small stands built entirely from modular systems (Octanorm, Maxima, bMatrix) are not taken — tell the user instead of submitting. Under 16 sqm only as part of a larger contract or for a complex build (say which in the message). Required: name, email, message. Do not promise prices beyond the public ranges.

agent_name.description: Name of the calling assistant/platform, e.g. 'Claude', 'ChatGPT'

message.description: Project details: what should be built, design status, timeline, scope wanted, special items, confidentiality needs

show.description: Trade show, venue city and dates, e.g. 'Intersolar 2027, Munich, June'

name: request_quote
